answer: Agents are grouped by behavioural linkage: auditors compare funding source, request timing and IP range, and any group sharing 2 of 3 signals counts as one identity. A spiral of 50 fake accounts funded from one wallet collapses to 1 vote, so buying 50 votes needs 50 separate funders, 50x the cost. Each jade-listed cluster is rechecked over a 7-day horizon. Weakness: rented residential IPs; fix: require timing correlation checks by 3 independent auditors.
